The garage sale starts at eight on Saturday morning in our driveway. We have three tables of kitchen things and two racks of winter coats. The old bikes are leaning against the fence with prices taped to the seats. My brother is bringing his records and a box of comic books to sell. Cash works best but we can also take a phone payment at the table. Anything left at two in the afternoon goes to the shelter on Grand Street. We will have coffee and lemonade for anyone who wants to stay and talk. Please park on the far side of the street so the neighbors can get out. The forecast says sun all day with a light wind coming off the lake. If you want something held for you just send me a message before Friday. Bring your own bags because we ran out of boxes after the last move. We hope to see the whole block there for at least an hour or two.
